tema: Present Simple — Daily Routines · Ola B: La Rutina Nocturna de Ben

banco_oraciones.oracion: Ben wakes up late and takes photos at sunset.
He edits photos at night and checks his email.
His camera sleeps more than he does.
Ben does not wake up early.
He doesn't work in the morning.
Does Ben edit photos every night?
What time does he have lunch?
Does he take photos at sunset? Yes, he does.
Do you stay up late? No, I don't.

interaccion: Ben: I **wake up** at eleven. Sofía **starts** work at eight. We live in different worlds.
Sofía: Ben **doesn't have** a morning. He **has** a long afternoon.
Abuela Carmen: The night **has** its own workers. My Ben **takes** photos of the moon.

banner_diagnostico.opcion_a: Ben wake up late every day.
banner_diagnostico.opcion_b: Ben wakes up late every day.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: We use the present simple to talk about routines and things we always do; with he/she/it the verb takes an '-s' at the end.

ejercicios.afirmacion: With he/she/it, we add '-s' to the verb: 'Ben wakes up late'.
The correct question is: 'Does Ben wakes up late?'

ejercicios.texto_con_error: He don't work in the morning.
ejercicios.respuesta: He doesn't work in the morning.

ejercicios.texto_con_error: Does Ben edits photos at night?
ejercicios.respuesta: Does Ben edit photos at night?
Ben does not edit photos every night.

ejercicios.oracion_base: Does he take photos at sunset?

ejercicios.respuesta: Ben doesn't work in the morning.

ejercicios.pregunta: What time do you have lunch? (Answer with a full sentence.)

guion: Sofía: What does Ben do every day?
Kenji: He wakes up at eleven and has lunch at two.
Kenji: He takes photos at sunset and edits them at night.
Kenji: Yes, he does. He sleeps from four to eleven.

comprension.pregunta: What time does Ben wake up?
When does Ben edit his photos?

reading.texto: Ben is a photographer, and his routine is upside down. He wakes up at eleven and has lunch at two. In the afternoon, he walks around the city with his camera. He takes photos at sunset, when the light is golden. At night, he edits photos and checks his email. He does not work in the morning — the morning does not exist for Ben. He goes to bed at four. His friends say he is a bat with a camera.

preguntas.afirmacion: He takes photos in the morning.
He goes to bed at ten.
